Two steps: tap here, switch on Wireless debugging, then tap “Pair device with pairing code” — Momoding does the rest
First switch on Momoding\'s accessibility: it reads the pairing code for you
Wireless debugging is off: tap to switch it back on (no need to pair again)

Uses Android\'s own wireless debugging, paired with this phone itself: nothing else to install, no computer. Developer options must be on (Settings → About phone → tap the build number 7 times). Most phones switch wireless debugging off when they restart; switch it back on, no need to pair again.
Tap “Pair device with pairing code”; Momoding reads the code
Didn\'t see the pairing dialog. Try again from Momoding.
Pairing didn\'t work. Try again (the code changes each time).
